name: – Céline Imart – After recital 28 – Am 33
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on providing macro-financial assistance to the Arab Republic of Egypt
part_text: (28 a) All external financial instruments adopted by the Union should be in line with the United Nations Human Rights Council’s guiding principles to ensure economic recovery measures. Namely, economic policymaking must be anchored and guided by substantive human rights impact assessments, crucial to ensuring that economic reforms advance, rather than hinder, the enjoyment of human rights by all, including the prohibition of retrogression.
